nodes.summary: The Ising model on a finite graph `G` with field `h`, as Physlib's finite canonical ensemble: microstates are spin configurations, the energy is `hamiltonian G h`, and the measure is the counting measure.
nodes.title: Ising model as a Physlib canonical ensemble

nodes.summary: The Hamiltonian `hamiltonian G h` is Physlib's Ising energy `CondensedMatter.IsingModel.energy` of the model with coupling `J = 1` and field `h`, on the region of all vertices.
nodes.title: Hamiltonian agrees with Physlib's Ising energy

nodes.summary: The nearest-neighbour graph `hypercubicLattice d` on `ℤ^d` is isomorphic to the bond graph of Physlib's hypercubic crystal `CondensedMatter.Crystal.hypercubicGraph d`, by sending `x` to the site in cell `x`.
nodes.title: Isomorphism of the hypercubic lattice with Physlib's crystal graph

nodes.summary: The Ising Gibbs probability at inverse temperature `T.β` is Physlib's canonical probability of `canonicalEnsemble G h` at temperature `T`.
nodes.title: Ising Gibbs probability agrees with Physlib's canonical probability

nodes.summary: The Ising partition function at inverse temperature `T.β` is Physlib's mathematical partition function of `canonicalEnsemble G h` at temperature `T`.
nodes.title: Ising partition function agrees with Physlib's partition function

nodes.summary: Two sites of `ℤ^d` are at `ℓ¹` distance one exactly when they differ by a unit vector.
nodes.title: Sites at $\ell^1$ distance one are those differing by a unit vector

nodes.summary: The Boolean spin value `spinB` is Physlib's `CondensedMatter.IsingModel.spin`.
nodes.title: Boolean spin agrees with Physlib's Ising spin

nodes.summary: The edge sum of `bond s` is half the sum of `σ_x σ_y` over ordered adjacent pairs.
nodes.title: Edge bond sum is half the sum over ordered adjacent pairs

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
